profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | E-Commerce, FinTech, Payments, Platform. Scaled a fintech product to 1.5M accounts, cut $75K+/month in infrastructure costs, from architecture to production.
profile.summary:
Michael Roberts is a software engineer based in Orlando, FL. When he's not immersed in a computer, he enjoys spending his free time swimming and enjoying the weather.

Specialties: React, React Native, Typescript, Angular, Capacitor, Node, PHP, Ionic

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led data caching project with DynamoDB to cache processor data and cut down on real-time API requests, saving ~$75,000 per month and improving performance for customer-facing applications
• Mentored 6 junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance, with multiple mentees progressing to independent feature ownership
• Architected and launched a full rebuild of customer-facing web (Next.js) and mobile applications (React Native) with internationalization support for Visa Direct remittance, enabling remittance expansion into 5 countries
• Delivered an end-to-end transaction push notification system via Blueshift, reaching over 300,000 notifications per day at peak
• Launched Virtual Card feature by extending card issuance infrastructure and coordinating across multiple teams, issuing 50,000+ cards within 4 months
• Designed and shipped a new transaction ingestion pipeline from the ground up resulting in query time reduction from multiple seconds to sub-100 milliseconds and optimized schema to support our 500 million row transaction table  
• Swapped card printing infrastructure while actively printing cards, including a new image processing pipeline, smoothly transitioning from Arroweye to FIS CardPro with no downtime in card shipping, while shipping 1,000 cards per day on average
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) and +9 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Ramon, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Drove a 75% relative lift in signup conversion (12% to 21%) through A/B testing design and performance improvements via VWO across a public-facing site with over 1 million monthly visitors
• Launched a net-new DDA banking product on Galileo and Pathward in TypeScript, Node.js, MySQL, gRPC, and Kubernetes on AWS, scaling to over 1.5 million accounts in a regulated, high-availability environment with strict uptime and compliance requirements
• Designed and developed Android and iOS mobile apps in React Native with custom native plugins for Ingo Money and Blueshift, enabling mobile check deposit and targeted push notifications, reaching 500,000 MAU at peak
• Shifted fraud detection from post-signup account closure to real-time signup prevention, denying fraudulent actors before account creation and saving over $10,000 per month in first-party fraud losses and onboarding costs
• Redesigned CI/CD pipeline across multiple repositories by removing bloated dependencies, implementing build caching, and parallelizing builds, reducing container build times from 15-20 minutes to 2 minutes and cutting total PR to deploy time from 45+ minutes to under 10
• Architected an in-house analytics pipeline via Kinesis Streams and Firehose into Redshift, processing millions of events per day and replacing manual reporting with real-time business decisioning across the full product
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Kinesis and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Built mobile apps for Android and iOS using Angular, Ionic, and Capacitor and wrote custom plugins for our third party partners, Ingo Money and Blueshift enabling mobile check deposit, self-service card management, and targeted marketing campaigns, reaching 300,000 MAU at peak
• Shipped a P2P card-to-card feature enabling real-time money transfers between prepaid card accounts, including a transaction history endpoint for cardholder record-keeping, processing over 150,000 transfers for over $12 million monthly at peak
• Architected a custom read-only security token solution providing scoped API access for customers to check their balance and recent transactions without a full login session
• Engineered SMS text message notification API integrating the FIS card processor backend, enabling cardholders to configure real-time transaction alerts via text message, delivering millions of notifications per month at peak

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description:
• Created a browser extension enabling upload of any content source including web pages, documents, or live meeting transcripts via bot invitation, directly into a vectorized AI knowledge base for AI-powered search
• Engineered end-to-end Zoom recording pipeline encompassing webhook ingestion, Zoom API transcript and recording retrieval, vectorization, and knowledge base indexing, delivering fully searchable meeting content automatically after every call
• Optimized AWS S3 processing pipelines and Lambdas to extract and clean file content prior to vectorization, reducing LLM token consumption by 80%
• Integrated recall.ai to deploy AI meeting bots across six platforms including Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, automatically generating summaries and searchable meeting records from every recorded session
• Prototyped in-platform video calling via Daily.co API with end-to-end transcript and recording capture, S3 storage, and vectorization via async queues, establishing the foundation for the platform's meeting intelligence pipeline
